title: Assistant Sourcing Manager
description:
To manage the end-to-end sourcing process for apparel products, including but not limited to fabrics, trims, and finished garments. OTIF is the primary KRA for this role along with identifying and developing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, ensuring quality standards, and optimizing costs to meet the company's apparel production needs. The Sourcing Manager plays a critical role in maintaining the quality and profitability of our apparel business.

Key Responsibilities:

* Supplier Management:

o Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with suppliers who can meet the company's quality, cost, and capacity requirements.

o Develop and maintain strong partnerships with existing suppliers to ensure reliability and consistent product quality.

o Monitor supplier performance, conduct regular audits, and address any issues or non-compliance.

* OTIF Management :

o On time in fulfilment – Primary KRA for this role. Ensuring to launch all products on the launch date in fulfilment. This will involve capacity planning and production planning with suppliers along with ensuring all levers for timely inspection are in place.

o To conduct the annual review of supplier performance with QA.

o To pursue and recover all money due from vendors as a result of performance penalties or markdown and promotional contributions.

o Ensures timely delivery of samples by vendors where the product can go through a first-time right approval.

* Cost Optimization:

o Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers to achieve cost savings while maintaining product quality.

o Analyze market trends and work with suppliers to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.

o Continuously review and optimize the supply chain to improve cost-efficiency.

Quality Control:

o Set and maintain strict quality standards for all apparel products.

o Work closely with suppliers to ensure that products meet quality specifications and conduct inspections when necessary.

o Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with suppliers.

* Procurement Strategy:

o Develop and execute a strategic sourcing plan for the apparel business in alignment with overall company goals.

o Monitor market dynamics and global trends to make informed decisions about sourcing locations and strategies.

o Manage lead times, inventory levels, and order quantities to meet demand.

* Risk Management:

o Identify potential risks in the supply chain and develop contingency plans to mitigate disruptions.

o Stay updated on global trade regulations and compliance requirements for the apparel industry.

o Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure adherence to international standards.

* Vendor Contracts and Agreements:

o Negotiate, draft, and manage contracts and agreements with suppliers.

o Ensure that all terms and conditions are favorable to the company's interests and compliant with legal and ethical standards.

·

**Education Qualifications:**

· Bachelor's degree in Garment management, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Senior Manager - Regional Logistics
description:
**About the Job:**
We are looking for a dynamic Regional Logistics Manager to lead secondary distribution operations within the assigned branch territory. The role is responsible for ensuring best-in-class service levels at optimum cost, while staying fully compliant on storage, transportation, sustainability, safety and security standards.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that combines strategic network design with hands-on execution, working closely with Sales, O2C, Finance, Factories, HO Logistics, 3PL partners, transporters and Carrying & Forwarding Agents (CFAs) to deliver a seamless end-to-end distribution experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Distribution & Transportation Management**

* Manage Cost of Distribution (COD) by optimizing inbound and outbound delivery (E2E) to control Total Delivered Cost (FDC / VDC / % COD).
* Drive Distribution Network Redesign, Logistics Excellence and related projects across delivery transportation and downstream warehouse operations.
* Prepare the Transport strategy along with T-Hub, onboard new carriers for downstream operations, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Complete formalities and ensure recovery of accident/loss claims for primary and secondary movements.

**Warehouse & DC Operations**

* Lead DC improvement projects – manpower productivity, MHE utilization, DIDO/GIGO improvement, warehouse utilization – ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Prepare warehouse strategy and manage new infrastructure transitions in line with business volume progression (OPL/MBS).
* Ensure 100% cycle count and inventory accuracy along with adherence to internal & external compliance guidelines.

**Service Levels & Customer Fulfilment**

* Maintain COF / OTIF / ZATP, reduce CD OOS and secondary OTRs.
* Resolve CD complaints related to shortages/damages and drive corrective actions.
* Coordinate with the Sales team and O2C team to onboard new customers post CSP alignment and ensure full supply.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure cool chain compliance in downstream storage and transportation (DC to Distributor).

description:

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY – GDS**
–
**Consulting – Finance**
As part of our EY - Finance Consulting Team, you will help clients develop their Performance Improvement initiatives and identify potential opportunities for performance improvements drive them. This includes techno-functional role conducting finance processes assessments, deep diving and analysing pain areas and coming up with solutions. The client base spans across industries and countries.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in BPRA (Business Planning Reporting & Analytics), and BPRA Process Assessment assignments. Also, experience in, Financial Accounting and Reporting domain
**is an added advantage**
to join the global EY - Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledge on Financial Planning and Budgeting Processes, Financial Consolidation, Cost Allocation and Controllership, EPM tools
* Focus on the design and implementation of operating models in BPRA
* Design, configuration and implementation of BPRA processes in EPM tools
* Lead forecasting and financial planning process (Budgeting and long-range financial plan) for the client/enterprise by analyzing the trends of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as sales, expenditures, profit margin etc.
* Transform the overarching company strategy into a long-range plan, annual budget, capital budgets and forecast
* Advice capital allocation plan, revenue plan, Opex/Capex plan, and key cost drivers to create / revise Income statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Forecasts
* Model how BPRA teams use information from multiple sources to model new assumptions, run sensitivity analysis and test alternatives, leverages analytical models and systematic projections (using in market expectations and other macro-trends) to identify updates required
* Review and explain key drivers, managing risks and opportunities, and updated forecast with Regional and Local leads, consolidating submissions and revisions from BUs, adjustments made as needed
* Provide regular/ad hoc strategic support to executive leadership (onshore/client) and provide support on current and future outlook, target setting outcome etc.
* Identify improvement opportunities in BPRA domain
* Process re-design and optimisation (AS-IS & TO-BE) leveraging BPM tools
* Identification of KPIs for CXO reporting and dashboarding
* Perform vendor analysis and prepare relevant analysis reports for clients
* Configuration and know how on activity-based costing models
* Partner directly with onshore finance teams/clients to collaborate on metrics, goals and business reviews
* Perform cost Accounting & cost categorization (People & Non people cost)
* Standardisation and streamline close processes leveraging leading practices and technology
* CoA design/re-design as per management and statutory reporting needs
* Build Management Reporting in tools like Power BI / Tableau / Qlik Sense / OneStream / Jedox / Anaplan / Hyperion / Board EPM
* Good Knowledge on ledger and sub-ledger systems; technical know-how of SAP ERP / HANA, Oracle GL (good to have)
* Knowledge in finance functions – ‘Record to report’, processes involving account reconciliations, Journals, Transaction matching, Variance analysis, intercompany and Fixed assets accounting / management (Good to have process knowledge of Procure to Pay and Order to Cash)
* Working knowledge of GBS / SSC setup engagements
* Should have knowledge of activities in financial close of an organisation for month / Quarter / Annual close periods
* Translate business requirements to technical language and model (good to have)
* Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure
* Open to travel (Domestic & International)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks and adapt to a changing environment
* Must be organized, focused, and driven to meet established deliverable deadlines
* Ability to lead client workshops and guide on BPRA vision and strategy
* Agile, Learnability and problem-solving approach
* Consulting experience is a must have
* Confident & professional communication style
* Proficiency in English (oral and written)
* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
* Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
* 10-15 years of work experience in BPRA projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Finance Transformation
* GBS/SSC Setup
* Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience
* Exposure to tools like ERP, EPM tools, Visio, ARIS, etc.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY Advisory practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: SAP FI-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Consulting - FICO Senior Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
  
  
In this role we are looking for an experienced SAP S4 HANA FI Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI/CO landscape
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* The primary function of this position is to work as a team member in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively to the area of SAP S4 HANA FICO General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts receivable, Bank Accounting Taxation, and Fixed Assets functionalities, Cost center and profit center Accounting, knowledge in COPA, Marginal Analysis, Product Costing and Material Ledger with a preferred background in the relevant industry.
* The Specialist will work in the implementation of all the above modules as part of the S4HANA Finance Transformation project, ensuring seamless integration with other third‑party systems.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus

**What We Look For**

* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / ICMA/ MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 7 to 10 years in SAP FI.
* Experience of having worked in an onsite- offshore delivery model
* Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions
* Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
* Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.

+ SAP Finance – FI- Organization structure, New General Ledger, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Accounts Receivable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
+ Controlling- CO-Cost Center Accounting, CO-Profit Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge and Hands on experience in CO-Profitability Analysis & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling) and Material Ledger Actual Costing.
+ FI integration with MM, SD, PP & PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Co Founder & CEO l Food Health & Wellness Ecosystems l Startup l Idea Stage
description:
**NutriGets is Looking for a Co-founder & CEO (+ 1 Builder) | Kolkata
  
  
Review the full job details and screening questions before applying. If anything doesn't work for you, kindly hold off on applying.**
Location: Kolkata (on-ground involvement required).
  
Type: Full-Time, Founding Leadership Role.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This is NOT a typical CEO role. As Co-Founder & CEO, you will be the strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and driving the organization forward. This role demands a passionate entrepreneur who thrives in startup environments, takes ownership end-to-end, and is eager to build something meaningful from the ground up.
  
  
This is a full-time, onsite role in Kolkata, not an advisory position. You will work closely with co-founders and stakeholders to translate vision into impact.
  
  
**Who can avoid**
\* People looking for a structured corporate role.
  
\* Strategy only professionals.
  
\* Those expecting high fixed salaries from Day one.
  
\* This is a full-time, onsite role in Kolkata.
  
\* We are looking for a true co-founder, not an employee with a title.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Vision, Strategy & Roadmap:**
• Define and execute the company's long-term vision across multiple verticals including technology platforms, consumer products, and supply-chain driven businesses.
  
• Design a phased expansion strategy - prioritizing focus, validation, and scalability at each stage.
  
• Balance short-term execution with long-term ecosystem building.
  
  
**Business Building & Execution**
• Lead the company from idea stage to launch, growth, and expansion.
  
• Own the development of business models, revenue strategies, pricing, and unit economics across verticals.
  
• Ensure strong execution discipline while operating in high-ambiguity environments.
  
  
**Operations & Cross-Functional Leadership**
• Build and manage operations across technology, product, marketing, supply chain, partnerships, and customer experience.
  
• Establish systems, SOPs, compliance frameworks, and performance metrics.
  
• Oversee execution across both digital platforms and physical operations as the company evolves.
  
  
**Fundraising & Financial Leadership**
• Lead fundraising strategy across seed, pre-Series, and future rounds.
  
• Manage investor relationships, board communication, and stakeholder alignment.
  
• Own financial planning, capital allocation, cost control, and long-term sustainability.
  
  
**Team Building & Culture**
• Build a strong founding team and leadership pipeline.
  
• Recruit senior leaders as new verticals are launched.
  
• Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and ethical business practices.
  
  
**Brand, Partnerships & External Leadership**
• Act as the public face of the company with investors, partners, regulators, and media.
  
• Build strategic partnerships across healthcare, wellness, FMCG, agriculture, and technology ecosystems.
  
• Drive trust, credibility, and long-term brand equity.
  
  
**Who You Are**
**\***
Someone who has worked in/with startups (FoodTech, D2C, B2B, Ops-heavy models)
  
**\***
A builder who enjoys execution more than just strategy
  
**\***
Comfortable working in uncertainty and solving real-world problems daily
  
**\***
Obsessed with growth, numbers, and getting things done.
  
**\***
Launch and run the first operational unit.
  
**\***
Build the business from 0 ₹50 lakhs/month.
  
**\***
Handle execution, investors, operations, growth, and team building, etc.
  
**\***
Create a scalable model for expansion.
  
**\***
Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience across startups, scale-ups, or complex businesses.
  
**\***
Proven track record of building and scaling businesses from early stages.
  
**\***
Experience working across Food / Consumer \* Brands, HealthTech & FMCG or Consumer Goods.
  
**\***
Demonstrated experience in P&L ownership, fundraising, and team leadership.
  
  
**Strategic & Execution Skills**
**\***
Strong ability to think long-term while executing relentlessly in the present.
  
**\***
Deep understanding of consumer behavior, operational complexity, and scalability.
  
**\***
Comfort navigating regulated or semi-regulated sectors.
  
**\***
Ability to prioritize focus while planning for future vertical expansion.
  
  
**Leadership Traits**
**\***
Founder mindset with extreme ownership.
  
**\***
High resilience, adaptability, and decision-making confidence.
  
**\***
Strong ethical compass and commitment to building trusted brands.
  
**\***
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
**\***
Experience launching or managing multi-business or multi-brand organizations.
  
**\***
Exposure to digital health, FoodTech, wellness platforms.
  
**\***
Experience working with institutional investors or venture capital.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Unique**
• Opportunity to co-found and lead a multi-vertical ecosystem, not just a single startup.
  
• Permanent equity ownership in a long-term vision.
  
• Ability to shape strategy, culture, and impact from day one.
  
• Build businesses that intersect technology, health, sustainability, and consumer trust.
  
• Long-term wealth creation opportunity.

title: Technical Lead - VIM for SAP
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Technical Lead - VIM for SAP
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32591**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Technical Lead in this position will be responsible for all solution components of the Vendor Invoice Management solution. And contribute to configuration, continuous improvements and standardizations of VIM solutions across SAP systems with the objective to optimize exception, approval and blocked invoice workflows and to increase efficiencies and to maximize the level of automation of the full end-to-end process.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* The Technical Lead will be responsible for handling the incident & problem resolution (3rd level support) within defined SLAs and set priorities in close collaboration with Corporate IT and regional IT teams (2nd level support) and with business stakeholders in regions EMEA and APAC Regression testing & regression test support during major releases and system upgrades
* And support the development of automated tests
* Also, gather and analyze business requirements, translate these requirements into functional and technical scope and functional specifications
* Ans also, design, build and implement improvements and new functional solutions for Vendor Invoice Management processes in SAP based on state-of-the-art SAP standard system capabilities and technical standards, complying with Linde IT standards and IT strategy and fully meeting business requirements
* You will also be required to identify opportunities for process improvements, efficiencies and cost reductions, leveraging S/4Hana capabilities and new VIM functionality
* And coordinate the implementation of new VIM functionality in SAP ECC and S/4Hana Systems according to Linde plc project management guidelines
* You must contribute in knowledge transfer/guidance to and training preparation and delivery for IT and business stakeholders of new IT functionalities and IT solutions
* And collaborate and consult with business and IT teams or stakeholders and manage external service providers to deliver highly dependable, secure, and integrated solutions meeting compliance requirements to the business
* Lastly, cross-skilling team members to allow growth of team members, distribution of knowledge across team members and a more flexible work allocation.

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* You must have a bachelor's degree in business informatics, Business Administration, or equivalent qualification
* And Global Certification(s) in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred
* A must is also 6+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large-scale systems in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (VIM), at a minimum experience in two end-to-end large scale VIM implementations.
* Along with Experience in working with onshore as well as offshore teams
* Knowledge on extensive skills in the implementation and optimization of Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (up to most up-to-date versions in SAP ECC and S/4Hana) and in the set-up, administration and optimization of Invoice Capture for SAP
* Must is In-depth knowledge of SAP and VIM standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Account Incharge
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Operations Management:**
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
  
  
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
  
  
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
  
  
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
  
  
**Inventory Control:**
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
  
  
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
  
  
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
  
  
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
  
  
**Team Leadership:**
Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.
  
  
Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
  
  
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
  
  
**Technology Utilization:**
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
  
  
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
  
  
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
  
  
**Customer Experience & Vendor Management:**
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Company Description**

INMYO is a climate-adaptive personal care and daily hygiene brand focused on high-performance solutions for sweat, odor, friction, humidity, and everyday body-skin concerns. Designed specifically for Indian weather and bodies in motion, the brand aims to help individuals stay fresh, comfortable, and confident in all environments. INMYO develops practical, effective products that align with active lifestyles and changing climates. The company emphasizes innovation, performance, and user comfort, creating solutions that fit seamlessly into daily routines.

**Role Description**

The Supply Chain Manager at INMYO will oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, ensuring timely availability of raw materials and finished goods to meet customer demand. This full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata includes managing demand planning, monitoring inventory levels, supervising procurement activities, and coordinating supply management processes. The role involves collaborating with manufacturing, logistics, and finance teams to optimize stock levels, reduce lead times, and control costs. The Supply Chain Manager will track key performance indicators, analyze data to improve operational efficiency, and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and vendors. The position also requires implementing best practices, supporting process improvements, and ensuring compliance with company policies and quality standards.

**Qualifications**

* Strong demand planning and analytical skills to forecast requirements and interpret supply chain data.
* Proficiency in supply management and inventory management to maintain optimal stock levels and ensure continuity of supply.
* Experience in procurement, including vendor management, negotiation, and sourcing of materials.
* Knowledge of supply chain systems or ERP tools and familiarity with FMCG or personal care product environments is beneficial.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.
* 3-5 years of experience with Bachelor’s or MBA degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., APICS, CPSM) are an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive continuous improvement in supply chain processes.

title: Project Officer, WINGS
description:
**Title:**
Project Officer, WINGS
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer
  
  
**Employment Status:**
Full Time
  
  
**Last update**
: 15th October 2026
  
  
Trickle Up has been enabling extremely poor people to build resilient livelihoods and emerge from the cycle of poverty adopting graduation approach. We target those who are most socioeconomically excluded across Asia, Africa, and the Americas- women, youth, people with disabilities, indigenous people, refugees, and other vulnerable groups who live beyond the reach of most social services and development programs. We drive large-scale change for these populations by partnering with governments, global institutions, and local organizations. In FY19, we reached 170,000 people across 19 countries. We have been registered and operating in India since 2005; our current footprint is focused on Jharkhand and Odisha States, where we reached 129,000 people in FY19. Reporting to the CEO, the Project Officer leads Trickle Up’s efforts within a priority state to scale Trickle Up’s evidence-based approach to graduating people out of ultra-poverty and contribute to Trickle Up’s continuous programme innovation efforts. We are seeking a highly motivated development professional with significant expertise in livelihood development for vulnerable populations, government partnerships, and training and managing partners.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for the right individual, who is energetic, motivated and desires to expand his/ her skills and expertise in Program Management in the NGO sector working with the poorest of the poor. Trickle Up provides professional growth opportunities for qualified professionals who are seeking to develop and broaden their technical and management skills and who will be working with a highly dynamic, fast-paced and energetic team.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Principal functions**
**Program Implementation**

* Lead implementation of programs in the slums of Kolkata to scale Trickle Up’s approach to graduating vulnerable populations out of ultra-poverty.
* Manage the successful execution of a multi-stakeholder projects in compliance with requirements, regulations, and good practices.
* Provide handholding support to women slum dwellers to come up with individual and group micro businesses.
* Ensure market linkage for the individual and group businesses.
* Contribute to the development of monitoring and evaluation systems..
* Regularly communicate program progress, results, and lessons learned to colleagues, partner organizations, and donors to support organizational learning and external representation.
* convergence with government departments to facilitate working of the women enterprise and its sustainability.

**Partnerships For Quality Programming**

* Explore possibilities of partnership with skill training institutions for skill building of women slum dwellers.
* Build the visibility of Trickle Up and identify new opportunities for partnership through representation in technical forums, working groups, and other forums.
* The program officer shall also be accountable for the IEC and Communication plan compliance for individual donors and Trickle Up in the intervention areas.
* Advise key stakeholders on good practices for graduating people out of ultra-poverty.
* Support the work of Trickle Up’s alliance of grassroots partner organizations through training and ongoing coaching to build the capacity of partner employees to plan, manage, execute, and learn from programs.

**Program Innovation**

* Contribute to the design of innovative, evidence-based programs that enable people to graduate out of ultra-poverty and contribute to the sector’s knowledge base.
* Contribute to the development of research objectives and partnerships to produce rigorous, actionable research for Trickle Up and strategic partners.
* Utilize monitoring and evaluation data and lessons learned to inform adaptive management of programs.

**Training And Capacity Building**

* Develop training modules and implement and lead the capacity-building of individual and group entrepreneurs
* Build coaching models across programs and monitor the progress of project participants based on the coaching provided on all aspect including skills building
* Support development of training and knowledge tools for improvising coaching in the intervention community with focus on areas of WaSH, functional literacyand other indicators followed by Trickle Up for well being of life.
* Building capacity of participants on mobile technology integration, accessing government schemes, and market information.

**Market Assessment & Value Chain Analysis**

* Organise and manage the market assessment & value chain analysis conducted by third party and providing necessary information to the consultant.
* Coordination & Communication between Trickle Up team and consultant in order to conduct the assessment and analysis.
* Organise meeting with SMT of Trickle Up to update the progress of the same.
* Implementation of recommendation provided by the consultant and accordingly identify the skills set needs to be developed by participants

**Budget Management**

* Ensure effective and timely monitoring and appropriate expenditure of project budget.
* Ensure budgets cover costs, including M&E, admin, overhead, and communications
* Ensure Budget is managed appropriately. Expenses are coded and spent on time and correctly

**Staff Management**

* Ensure that all direct reports have clear roles and responsibilities and are held accountable for delivering results
* Ensure direct reports have support and tools they need to effectively do their jobs well
* Recruit, train and support staff

**M&E Management**

* In coordination with the MERL Lead, ensure that projects properly collect and analyze data in a timely manner

**Reporting, Donor Compliance And Learning Initiatives**

* The Project officer shall be the first node of data management and reporting as per the agreed Monitoring & Evaluation timeline of the program.
* The Project officer shall be responsible to support the rolling out of the learning initiatives agreed in the program and also provide feedback on the system at regular interval of time as agreed in the M & E timeline for the program.

**Qualifications**
**Academic:**

* Post-graduation or equivalent in Social Work/Sociology/Rural Development

**Working Experience**

* Demonstrated 7 years Program Management experience at field level working with field-based staff to ensure timely and quality program facilitation for international NGO;
* Overall experience managing livelihood ( Women lead micro enterprises) and/or gender focused programs working in partnership with local NGOs and/or CBOs.
* Experience working in partnership with government and state/national level entities (e.g. NRLM)
* Proven experience of handling projects involving linkages with market, industries, NGOs, National/State/ local organizations and government;

**Others**

* Deep commitment to Trickle Up’s core values and ability to model those values in relationships with colleagues and partners.
* Prior experience working in teams in a leadership role.
* Prior experience working in Odisha
* Experience with training highly desirable.
* Ability to travel frequently within the country.
* Ability to prioritize, organize and carry out multiple tasks efficiently under pressure and with little supervision; ability to accept supervision.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong writing and verbal skills in English, Bengali and exemplary communication skills.
* Skills in data analysis (quantitative and qualitative), and ensuring data quality, integrity and efficiency of collection.
* Skills in designing and implementing monitoring and evaluation systems, and distilling findings and learning for a range of audiences.
* Knowledge of digital approaches of program monitoring and evaluation.

**Behavioral competencies**

* Strong attention to detail
* Able to prioritize, manage multiple tasks, and consistently meet deadlines
* Works well both independently and as a member of a team
* Optimistic, creative, and solutions-oriented; tackles challenges with maturity and accountability
* Superb people skills and diplomatic demeanor
* Understands the challenges and opportunities of working in a small nonprofit setting
* Demonstrated commitment to mission-driven work

**TRAVEL Requirements**
Must be able to travel domestically at least 50% of the time to remote areas, at short notice.
  
  
**Salary And Benefits**

* Commensurate with qualifications and experience

**To Apply**

* To be considered, all candidates must fulfill the above prerequisites, provide a complete CV, covering letter referencing the required functions, skills and experience, and a writing sample, preferably a sole authored piece related to research or evaluation. Incomplete application will not be accepted.

: https://trickleup.hire.trakstar.com/jobs/fk0zn6b

We value a diverse workforce and extend equal opportunity to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Team Leader
description:
****Job Description****
**About TaskUs:**
TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
  
  
The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
  
  
It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
  
  
**Job Description**
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
  
  
Being a
**Team Leader**
, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.
  
  
You must be adept at creating reports of your team's performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
  
  
So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
  
  
****Requirements:****
So, what are we looking for?
  
  
We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 + teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.
  
  
If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that's a plus in your favor. If you're familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.
  
  
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
TaskUs is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
****How We Partner To Protect You:****
TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
  
  
****DEI:****
In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
  
  
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
**https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise

* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

+ IT Operating Model optimization
+ Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
+ Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
+ Product strategy & management
+ M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. * Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 15+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* 15+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Your role will involve operations management, client coordination, project monitoring, team management, resource planning, and business development support. Here's a detailed breakdown of your responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities:

1. Overall Operations Management

Oversee the day-to-day operations of Graphē and ensure smooth functioning across departments.

Establish and maintain operational processes, SOPs, workflows, and reporting systems.

Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies and implement solutions.

Coordinate between different departments to ensure timely execution of projects and internal requirements.

Monitor resource utilisation, workload, deadlines, and team productivity.

2. Project & Workflow Management

Ensure projects are properly planned, assigned, monitored, and delivered within agreed timelines.

Coordinate with Team Heads and Project Managers to track project progress and deliverables.

Maintain visibility of ongoing projects, pending tasks, dependencies, and critical deadlines.

Escalate delays, quality issues, or resource constraints to management at the appropriate stage.

Improve internal workflows to increase efficiency and reduce unnecessary delays.

3. Client Coordination & Relationship Management

Act as a key point of contact for clients wherever operational or coordination support is required.

Understand client requirements and ensure they are communicated clearly to the relevant internal teams.

Monitor client satisfaction, deliverables, timelines, and pending approvals.

Build and maintain long-term professional relationships with existing clients.

Identify opportunities for additional services and coordinate with the management/business development team for potential business growth.

4. Business Development Support

Support management in identifying new business opportunities and potential clients.

Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and business documentation.

Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, discussions, and onboarding of new clients.

Maintain a structured database of prospects, leads, clients, and business opportunities.

Track business opportunities from initial enquiry through conversion and onboarding.

5. Recruitment & Talent Management

Understand manpower requirements across Graphē's different departments.

Prepare and update job descriptions, KRAs, and role requirements in coordination with Team Heads.

Source, screen, and shortlist suitable candidates for creative, technical, marketing, and operational positions.

Coordinate interviews, assignments, assessments, and selection processes.

Maintain a recruitment pipeline and candidate database.

Coordinate onboarding and ensure new employees have the required information, resources, and access to begin their roles effectively.

6. Team & Resource Coordination

Work closely with Team Heads to understand current and upcoming manpower requirements.

Monitor workload distribution and assist in balancing resources across projects.

Support management in identifying performance, productivity, or behavioural concerns.

Facilitate communication between teams and help resolve operational conflicts.

Ensure teams follow established company processes, policies, and reporting systems.

7. Performance & Process Monitoring

Track departmental and individual performance against defined KRAs and KPIs.

Maintain operational reports and dashboards for management review.

Monitor attendance, leave, task completion, productivity, and other operational parameters where applicable.

Identify recurring issues and recommend corrective or preventive measures.

Support performance review and improvement processes.

8. Internal Administration & Compliance

Ensure company policies and internal procedures are properly communicated and followed.

Coordinate documentation related to employees, clients, vendors, and operational processes.

Maintain important operational records and databases.

Coordinate with accounts, HR, legal, and other support functions wherever required.

Ensure timely completion of administrative and compliance-related requirements.

9. Vendor & External Coordination

Coordinate with external vendors, freelancers, consultants, recruitment agencies, and service providers.

Evaluate operational requirements and coordinate quotations, negotiations, timelines, and deliverables.

Ensure external resources meet agreed quality and delivery standards.

10. Management Reporting & Decision Support

Prepare regular operational reports for the management.

Provide management with insights into team capacity, project status, recruitment requirements, client issues, and operational challenges.

Analyse operational data to identify areas for improvement.

Take ownership of assigned operational initiatives and drive them through to completion.

Key Performance Indicators:

1. Project Delivery & Efficiency

100% of projects delivered on/before deadline.

100% adherence to project budgets.

Reduction in turnaround time for revisions/approvals.

2. Team Productivity & Management

Designer utilization rate.

Employee satisfaction & retention in operations and creative teams.

Training & skill development sessions conducted per quarter.

3. Client Satisfaction & Retention

Client satisfaction score

Number of escalations resolved within SLA.

4. Financial & Resource Management

Cost savings achieved through efficient vendor and tool management.

Accuracy in resource allocation vs. actual usage (over/underutilization rate).

Budget variance

5. Process & Quality Improvement

Number of SOPs/process improvements implemented quarterly.

Reduction in design errors or rework requests.

Internal audit scores on process adherence.

6. Compliance & Risk

Adherence to client confidentiality and data security policies.

Number of compliance breaches (target: zero).

Safety and workplace compliance audit ratings.

Every role at Graphē is not just a job but a crucial piece in the mosaic of our creative venture. In this close-knit community, your performance is more than a mere task; it's the foundation on which our collective success rests. ‎

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**

It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

**Employer of Choice**
