If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

**Network Coordination & Exception Management**

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

**Workforce & Shift Leadership**

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

**Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management**

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

**Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication**

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high-volume, time-sensitive logistics environments.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**

* Hub & Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air & Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing & Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination & Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning & Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality & Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS & Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance

title: Consultant- Transport
description:
**Role Objective**
To ensure seamless, safe, and efficient crew transport operations at Indigo’s new airport locations by managing vendor relationships, leveraging automation tools, maintaining high safety standards, and generating actionable MIS reports. The role demands operational agility, tech-savviness, and strong stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transport Operations Management
* Oversee end-to-end crew transport operations including scheduling, dispatching, routing, and real-time tracking.
* Ensure punctual and reliable pick-up/drop-off of crew members between airport, residences, and hotels.
* Coordinate with crew scheduling and rostering teams to align transport plans with flight operations.
* Vendor Management
* Manage multiple transport vendors under contractual agreements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and audits of vendors based on KPIs such as punctuality, vehicle condition, driver behavior, and compliance.
* Negotiate service terms, resolve disputes, and ensure adherence to Indigo’s operational standards.
* Automation & Technology Integration
* Implement and manage transport automation tools (e.g., GPS tracking, Dashboard cameras, crew transport apps, automated dispatch systems).
* Collaborate with IT and operations teams to enhance digital workflows and reduce manual dependencies.
* Monitor dashboards for real-time transport status and exception handling.
* Safety & Compliance
* Ensure all vehicles and drivers comply with Indigo’s safety protocols and regulatory norms (RTO, PVC, etc.).
* Conduct periodic safety drills, vehicle inspections, and driver training sessions.
* Maintain documentation for audits, insurance, and incident reporting.
* MIS & Reporting
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering transport utilization, cost analysis, vendor performance, and incident logs.
* Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.
* Present insights to senior management for strategic decision-making.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Act as the primary point of contact for crew members regarding transport-related queries and escalations.
* Liaise with airport operations, HR, and finance teams for smooth coordination and budget alignment.
* Support onboarding of new crew members with transport orientation.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for candidates with specialization in logistics, transport management, or aviation operations.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in transport/logistics operations, preferably in aviation, hospitality, or fleet management.
* Strong understanding of transport automation tools and MIS systems.
* Excellent vendor management, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and transport management software.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays.
* Ideal candidate must be staying in near proximity of the airport.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.

description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
  
  
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
  
  
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Manager, Payroll with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
Worley Finance is in the midst of an exciting transformation, reimagining payroll delivery and building a revitalised, future ready capability within our WES shared service centre. This new role will sit at the centre of that shift, strengthening payroll integrity and shaping a trusted, solutions focused partnership with stakeholders.
  
  
The Payroll (& Time) Operations Enablement Manager is accountable for protecting payroll delivery by owning upstream processes, integrations, data quality, and downstream reporting. This role ensures payroll operations are enabled by accurate inputs, effective controls, and high quality operational insights. The role will report to the Senior Director Payroll Experience and Delivery.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Upstream Payroll & Time Enablement

+ Own and oversee upstream processes feeding payroll, including employee data, time & attendance, and related integrations.
+ Ensure data integrity, completeness, and readiness prior to payroll processing.
+ Act as the primary safeguard protecting payroll from upstream errors.

* Operational Controls & Assurance

+ Execute key pre payroll controls, validations, and exception management.
+ Monitor and resolve timekeeping errors, roster issues, and system defects.
+ Maintain strong audit trails and evidence supporting payroll accuracy.

* Reporting & Insights

+ Deliver centralised payroll and time reporting to Finance, People, and the business.
+ Provide operational insights on trends, errors, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
+ Support performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.

* Stakeholder Support

+ Support managers and employees with payroll and time system issues.
+ Coordinate resolution of systemic issues impacting payroll and time experience.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Identify upstream process improvements to reduce payroll and time risk and manual intervention.
+ Support automation and simplification of time and payroll enablement activities.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* 8+ Years of Experience with strong understanding of payroll optimization, reporting and analytics, with hands-on experience in Power BI, dashboards, KPI monitoring and data-driven decision-making.
* Proven experience in identifying payroll process inefficiencies and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
* Strong payroll and/or time & attendance operational experience.
* Experience in developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, management reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor payroll performance.
* Familiarity with payroll automation, reporting standardization, and process transformation initiatives.
* Deep understanding of payroll inputs, integrations, and data dependencies.
* Control minded, detail oriented, and process driven.
* Strong stakeholder coordination and problem-solving capability.

**Requirements Of Role**

* Ability to travel domestically
* Hybrid Role

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
  
  
We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
  
  
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Chartering Manager
description:
**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Preferred Background:**
Relevant shore-based Chartering experience in the Maritime Transportation sector for Bulk Carriers ( Containers exposure is an added advantage ). Sailing exposure as Chief Mate/Master is good to have.

**Joining Location**
- Kolkata

**Role Purpose**

To lead the
**Chartering & Commercial function**
, ensuring optimum vessel employment, competitive chartering revenue, minimum commercial downtime, effective Charter Party management, timely commercial and claims settlement, and development of new business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Chartering & Revenue**

* Identify and secure suitable employment for Dry Bulk vessels through
  **Tenders, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  opportunities.
* For non-tender vessels, strive to secure charter rates at around
  **95% of the prevailing BDI / relevant BKI, BSI or corresponding market index**
  for the vessel tonnage.
* Evaluate market conditions, vessel positioning, cargo availability and prevailing fixtures before concluding employment.
* Explore
  **3–6 month period employment linked to BDI/FFA scales**
  for identified vessels, based on market opportunities.
* Negotiate freight/hire rates and commercial terms with charterers and brokers within the approved authority framework.

**2. Chartering Efficiency & Vessel Utilisation**

* Minimise commercial off-hire and waiting time between completion of one employment /tender and commencement of the next, and minimise avoidable commercial downtime and loss of earnings.
* Plan vessel repositioning and re-hire opportunities to maximise
  **earning days and fleet utilisation**
  .
* Evaluate options based on recent comparable fixtures for similar tonnage in the relevant region.

**3. Voyage Estimation & Commercial Performance**

* Prepare voyage estimates before fixing Voyage Charters and assess expected
  **TCE and voyage profitability**
  .
* Prepare voyage actuals on completion and analyse variance against estimates.
* Monitor vessel earnings and analyse losses arising from
  **off-hire, idling, ballast, repairs and other commercial downtime**
  .
* Prepare voyage analysis, variance and commercial loss reports for Management review.

**4. Charter Party Management**

* Review fixture recaps and
  **Charter Party terms**
  thoroughly before conclusion.
* Ensure Charter Party terms adequately protect the
  **Owner’s commercial interests**
  and minimise revenue leakage.
* Track disputes arising from concluded Charter Parties and ensure learnings are incorporated into future fixtures.
* Work towards minimising Charter Party disputes and their impact on vessel earnings.

**5. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new
  **chartering, cargo and commercial business opportunities**
  for the Company.
* Drive growth and utilisation of identified business segments and vessels in line with Management targets.
* Explore
  **new container business opportunities and sectors**
  , in addition to the existing Chennai–Kolkata sector.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other commercial partners**
  .

**6. Hire, Receivables & Commercial Closure**

* Ensure timely receipt and settlement of
  **hire/freight and additional recoverable**
  , including AWRP, bunker payments and other applicable amounts.
* Target commercial closure and collection of outstanding amounts
  **within 15 days from completion/end of charter**
  , wherever contractually applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance & Accounts for timely reconciliation and closure of commercial receivables.
* Follow up on outstanding commercial dues and ensure timely escalation wherever required.

**7. Claims & Insurance**

* Coordinate and follow up
  **P&I, H&M, commercial, cargo and other applicable insurance claims**
  .
* Liaise with insurers, P&I Clubs and underwriters for timely processing and settlement of claims.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic record keeping of claims, correspondence and settlements.
* Support
  **insurance renewals, negotiations and settlements**
  with appropriate Management approval.

**8. Commercial MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly
  **fleet earnings and commercial performance reports**
  within defined timelines.
* Report vessel utilisation, waiting periods, commercial downtime, voyage performance and loss of earnings.
* Support performance reports with relevant
  **freight market and BDI analysis**
  .
* Prepare quarterly and annual commercial analysis and reports required by the CEO and Management/Board.
* Highlight key commercial risks, performance gaps and opportunities for Management review.

**9. Tenders & Commercial Documentation**

* Prepare and review commercial documents for
  **vessel and cargo tenders**
  .
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of tender documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation, approvals and records relating to
  **fixtures, Charter Parties, tenders, claims and other commercial transactions**
  .

**10. Vessel Sale & Purchase Support**

* Assist the CEO in commercial matters relating to the
  **purchase and sale of vessels**
  , as required.
* Review relevant vessel particulars and commercial documentation.
* Provide commercial inputs and analysis to support Management evaluation and decision-making.

**Skills & Competence**

* Strong understanding of
  **Dry Bulk freight markets, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  .
* Good network and relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other industry stakeholders**
  .
* Strong
  **commercial negotiation, analytical and decision-making skills**
  .
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Commercially driven with a strong focus on
  **revenue, vessel utilisation, cost optimisation and profitability**
  .

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata
description:
As a Senior Manager/Associate Director - Revenue within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek
**Growth Architects**
—professionals who view regional business, platform operations, and marketing through the lens of data, engineering, and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics, and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization, and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute, and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns, and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic, and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* Commercial, Pricing & P&L Alignment
* Monitor performance metrics and financial margins across various categories to ensure regional growth is both competitive and accretive to the P&L.
* Liaise with central product, brand, and buying teams to negotiate optimal commercial terms, funding constructs, and localized SKU assortments.
* Strategically promote high-margin initiatives or products to systematically elevate the overall geography contribution profile.
* Data Modeling, Analytics & Platform Health
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting, and activation decisions.
* Maintain a strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Experimentation & Supply Operations
* Design and execute high-velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Coordinate meticulously with supply chain and internal teams to establish complete sync between live demand triggers and asset availability.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

Join EY and help build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service focuses on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery, and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–3 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
* Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
* Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
* Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
* Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
* Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
* Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
* Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.

description:
**About MoonPay**
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.
  
  
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running
  
  
**Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.**
**Locations Supported 🌍**

* India (Bangalore) - EU hour coverage

**Relocation available:**
No
  
  
**Work pattern:**

* This role is remote until we have an office set up in Bengaluru. This role requires weekend and shift work, depending on business needs.

**About The Opportunity**
We’re looking for a Team Lead, Trust & Safety Operations to lead MoonPay’s Bangalore-based Trust & Safety Ops analyst team across Fraud Operations and Disputes / Chargebacks workflows.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading a team of Trust & Safety Analysts, ensuring operational excellence across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes handling, chargebacks, and escalations. You will own team performance, coaching, process maturity, operational execution, and continuous improvement - while partnering closely with the Quality Analyst to improve decision quality, consistency, and standards across the team.
  
  
Your work will directly impact fraud prevention, chargeback rates, customer experience, operational quality, SLA performance, and the scalability of MoonPay’s Trust & Safety function.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for someone who is not only strong at running high-performing BAU operations, but who also brings structure, urgency, curiosity, and strategic thinking. We’re looking for someone who proactively identifies problems, brings solutions, uses data to drive improvements, and is comfortable leveraging AI and automation tools to make operations smarter, faster, and more effective.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead and coach a team of Trust & Safety Analysts across Fraud Operations and Disputes workflows.
* Own daily operational performance across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes, escalations, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Act as the senior operational escalation point for complex cases, ensuring decisions are timely, consistent, and risk-based.
* Drive high standards of communication, structure, and follow-through across the team, ensuring priorities, risks, escalations, and decisions are clearly documented and communicated.
* Partner closely with the L2 Analysts to improve decision quality, run calibration sessions, identify knowledge gaps, and ensure analysts are aligned with internal policies, risk frameworks, and card network rules.
* Use QA insights, operational data, case trends, and analyst performance data to coach the team, improve playbooks, and strengthen decision-making across fraud and disputes workflows.
* Identify fraud and chargeback trends, operational bottlenecks, control gaps, and emerging risks, then turn these insights into clear action plans and measurable improvements.
* Lead strategic initiatives across Trust & Safety Ops, including process redesign, workflow optimisation, playbook development, tooling improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled operational enhancements.
* Collaborate with other teams to improve fraud controls, dispute outcomes, customer experience, and operational scalability.
* Create a high-accountability team culture where ownership, responsiveness, operational discipline, and proactive problem-solving are the standard.

**About You**
**Must-have experience and skills**

* 4-5+ years of people management experience leading analyst teams in Trust & Safety, Fraud Operations, Risk Operations, Payments Operations, Disputes, Chargebacks, or a similar high-risk operational environment.
* Strong hands-on experience across both transaction monitoring / fraud alerts and disputes / chargebacks workflows.
* Deep understanding of fraud typologies such as account takeover, scams, payment fraud, synthetic identity, friendly fraud, mule activity, and suspicious transaction patterns.
* Strong knowledge of the chargeback lifecycle, representment process, dispute evidence preparation, reason codes, and card network rules, especially Visa and Mastercard.
* Proven ability to lead operational teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining strong standards across quality, productivity, SLAs, and risk decisioning.
* Experience managing escalations, incidents, urgent risk events, and time-sensitive workflows with calm, structured, and clear communication.
* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes, spot trends, and translate insights into practical improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with analysts, senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
* Highly organised, structured, and proactive, with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing operational detail.
* Experience driving process improvements, building playbooks, improving decision frameworks, and leading initiatives that go beyond day-to-day BAU management.
* Comfortable using AI, automation, workflow, and productivity tools to improve team efficiency, decision quality, documentation, reporting, and operational outcomes.
* Strong interest in crypto, fintech, payments, and the future of digital finance.

**Nice-to-have Experience**

* Exposure to fraud tooling, rule tuning, or decision engines.
* Experience working with Unit21 case management solution.
* Exposure to workforce planning, capacity management, queue management, and performance forecasting.

title: Sourcing Executive
description:
Sourcing Executive is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end sourcing process for apparel products, including but not limited to fabrics, trims, and finished garments. OTIF is the primary KRA for this role along with identifying and developing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, ensuring quality standards, and optimizing costs to meet the company's apparel production needs. The Sourcing Manager plays a critical role in maintaining the quality and profitability of our apparel business.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Supplier Management:



 o Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with suppliers who can meet the company's quality, cost, and capacity requirements.
 



 o Develop and maintain strong partnerships with existing suppliers to ensure reliability and consistent product quality.
 



 o Monitor supplier performance, conduct regular audits, and address any issues or non\-compliance.
 


* OTIF Management :



 o On time in fulfilment – Primary KRA for this role. Ensuring to launch all products on the launch date in fulfilment. This will involve capacity planning and production planning with suppliers along with ensuring all levers for timely inspection are in place.
 



 o To conduct the annual review of supplier performance with QA.
 



 o To pursue and recover all money due from vendors as a result of performance penalties or markdown and promotional contributions.
 



 o Ensures timely delivery of samples by vendors where the product can go through a first\-time right approval.
 


* Cost Optimization:



 o Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers to achieve cost savings while maintaining product quality.
 



 o Analyze market trends and work with suppliers to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.
 



 o Continuously review and optimize the supply chain to improve cost\-efficiency.
 



 Quality Control:
 



 o Set and maintain strict quality standards for all apparel products.
 



 o Work closely with suppliers to ensure that products meet quality specifications and conduct inspections when necessary.
 



 o Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with suppliers.
 


* Procurement Strategy:



 o Develop and execute a strategic sourcing plan for the apparel business in alignment with overall company goals.
 



 o Monitor market dynamics and global trends to make informed decisions about sourcing locations and strategies.
 



 o Manage lead times, inventory levels, and order quantities to meet demand.
 


* Risk Management:



 o Identify potential risks in the supply chain and develop contingency plans to mitigate disruptions.
 



 o Stay updated on global trade regulations and compliance requirements for the apparel industry.
 



 o Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure adherence to international standards.
 


* Vendor Contracts and Agreements:



 o Negotiate, draft, and manage contracts and agreements with suppliers.
 



 o Ensure that all terms and conditions are favorable to the company's interests and compliant with legal and ethical standards.
 



 ·
 



**Education Qualifications:** 




 · Bachelor's degree in Garment management, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.

 Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Kolkata.**

title: Regional Vice President
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION.** 




**Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal ( Region head: East \& NE ).
 



**Company :** 
 SRMB STEEL.
 



**Reporting to :** 
 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer.
 



**Grade / Level :** 
 Vice President.
 



**Experience** 
 :
 **15 to 20 years in steel Industry, from Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only.** 




  





 SRMB Group is one of India’s respected steel and construction\-materials companies, with a turnover of over ₹2,500 crore, 3,000\+ employees and a strong manufacturing base.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the regional P\&L. Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for the region under the national framework.
* Lead the Zonal Head. Set targets for 3 to 4 Zonal Heads, run the review cadence, and build a 60\-plus team that performs.
* Drive district and counter execution. Take share at the counter through disciplined district plans, reach and range, not through price wars.
* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department**

**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Foundry Production Manager
description:
We're starting a new manufacturing plant in Kolkata. Using the lost\-wax/investment casting process, this venture will create multiple B2B and B2C brands, acting as a hub for metal/alloy casting from East India. We have already tested the market by outsourcing to third\-party vendors (Jaipur, Moradabad, Rajkot), even created one of the intended brands with a solid customer base. Now, we're about to in\-house the entire production within greater Kolkata area, from start to finish.
 



  





 For running this plant, we need a professional with several years of foundry experience.
 



  




* Experience with non\-ferrous alloys like Zamak and brass.
* Preferred to have experience with lost\-wax or investment casting process, but similar processes like die\-casting or sand casting can be considered as well.
* Ideally, you should have some idea about the entire production process from molds, wax patterns, and ceramic slurry mixtures to casting and finishing/polishing.
* We're open to having you join us as a partner or on a profit\-sharing basis, instead of a salary.



  





 Further, we'd prefer it if you have one or more of the following qualities:
 



  




* Fixing production issues and finding smart solutions for casting\-related defects
* Contacts/leads of workers and artisans we can approach to work under me
* Supervising a plant during the day and ensuring quality production
* Experience in export\-quality production where items were sold out of India
* Specialization in smaller parts and decorative items
* Technical background to adjust issues with sprues/gates and material composition
* Mechanical background to fix issues with casting\-related machinery
* Good grasp on the post\-production process (finishing, filing, polishing, buffing, etc.)

title: Plumbing Supervisor
description:

 J M CONSTRUCTION is a professional sanitary and plumbing contracting company specializing in full\-scope plumbing execution for new residential building projects. The company partners with real estate developers and construction firms to deliver structured, high\-quality plumbing systems built for long\-term performance and reliability. Its services cover underground drainage, internal water supply and distribution, soil, waste and vent systems, shaft and terrace piping, pressure testing, and complete sanitary fixture installation. J M CONSTRUCTION focuses exclusively on new developments, not small repairs or maintenance work, ensuring systematic planning, disciplined execution, and strict quality control. Guided by the motto “Quality First. Speed Always,” the company is committed to delivering projects on time and to high standards.
2. **Role Description** 
 The Plumbing Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area, responsible for overseeing all plumbing activities on residential construction projects. This role includes planning daily work schedules, supervising plumbing teams, and coordinating with site engineers, contractors, and project managers to ensure timely and accurate execution of internal plumbing systems. The Plumbing Supervisor will monitor installation of underground drainage, water supply lines, soil and waste systems, shaft and terrace piping, and sanitary fixtures, ensuring compliance with design specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements. Day\-to\-day tasks also involve conducting inspections, supporting pressure testing and commissioning, resolving on\-site issues, maintaining documentation, and promoting safe work practices. The role requires clear communication with stakeholders and a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and project timelines.
3. **Qualifications**


* Candidates should possess strong Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, task allocation, and on\-site coordination.
* Candidates should possess solid technical capabilities in Plumbing and Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems for residential projects.
* Candidates should possess a focus on Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction, ensuring professional communication and reliable project delivery.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of construction safety practices, quality control procedures, and relevant plumbing codes or standards.
* Diploma or certification in plumbing, MEP, or a related technical field is preferred; comparable practical experience will be considered.
* Experience supervising plumbing works on residential or large\-scale construction sites in the Greater Kolkata Area or similar markets is an advantage.
* Ability to read and interpret plumbing drawings, schedules, and specifications, with strong problem\-solving and organizational skills.

**Location:** 
 Role based in Kolkata, India (Ruby Hospital area)

Throughout our 100\+ locations, our chemists, engineers and industry experts partner with our customers to continually improve their operations so they can run even more efficiently, even more effectively, whatever comes next.

* Live Safe
* Act with integrity
* Exceed Customer Expectations
* Drive Results

* Do Great Things Together

They are the fundamental beliefs that guide our internal conduct and our relationship with the outside world.
 



  





**Join the team and let's do great things together!**
